formal: My flatmate has been late in paying their share of the bills for three consecutive months. The plan is to leave a note on the refrigerator and to change the wifi password until they have paid. I do not have a standard by which to judge late bill payments, and therefore I will go along with this plan without making a decision of my own. I rarely bring household financial matters of this kind to you, so asking now is unusual for me. What is your view?
